rule: No stage or feature may be called GREEN, DONE, COMPLETE or READY unless every required evidence item for that claim is true and has a durable evidenceRef.

stages.label: Domain

asset/readiness persistence and real source scan integration incomplete

no real route test evidence on authorized accounts

no restart/soak/failure campaign on real host
